title: Mtu niliyemjua huko Clark mara nyingi alinipeleka kwa gari hadi Koreatown huko Angeles
label: Kuelekea Koreatown

text.In Koreatown, he took me to many differe: Huko Koreatown, alinipeleka kwenye migahawa mingi tofauti.
text.That is how often he took me somewhere e: Mara nyingi hivyo alinipeleka mahali fulani kila wikendi na kunipa uzoefu mwingi.
text.A drive in Angeles, Philippines: Safari ya gari huko Angeles, Ufilipino
text.Just 15 minutes by car in the Philippine: Eneo karibu na bweni langu Clark lilikuwa tulivu sana, kwa hiyo nilikuwa nikitembea mara nyingi.
text.About 20 minutes by car from where I liv: Takriban dakika 20 kwa gari kutoka nilipoishi, kulikuwa na Koreatown.
text.A Korean person I knew there often took: Mkorea mmoja niliyemjua huko mara nyingi alinipeleka huko.
text.I still faintly remember the smell insid: Bado nakumbuka kidogo harufu ndani ya gari lile na muziki wa Kikorea uliokuwa ukipigwa mara nyingi garini.
